dialogue.chat: A talk. Why not. The silence was getting smug anyway.
dialogue.chat/1: A conversation. Fine. The silence had gotten too pleased with itself anyway.
dialogue.chat/2: Talk, then. Better your voice than the wind and my own thoughts, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations: Talk. Sure. It passes the time until it doesn't.
dialogue.conversations/1: You want to talk. Alright. Words fill the quiet, if nothing else.
dialogue.conversations/2: Sit, then. Talk. It's cheaper than brooding and about as productive.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Good enough. The rain held off. That's as good as it gets.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Tolerable. The sky didn't fall. I've learned to call that a victory.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Fine, I suppose. Ask me again when the clouds come back and I'll sound more like myself.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Every day is a heavy few days, %1$s. But thank you for noticing this one.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: Heavy. They usually are. But you asked, and that's a small light. Thank you, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You asked already. The answer's the same shade of grey, %1$s. It doesn't change fast.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice now. My moods move slower than the seasons. Give it a month.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Nothing went wrong yet. I'm keeping my expectations where they belong.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Nothing broke. In my ledger that's the closest thing to a good day.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The usual. Grey sky outside, greyer one in here.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Grey outside, greyer in. The two keep each other company, at least.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: It keeps my hands busy so my head can't wander. That's worth something.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: It fills the hours so the thoughts can't. That's the nicest thing I'll say about it.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Does anyone like their work? Or do we all just agree not to ask.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: Like it? We tolerate each other, the work and I. Same as most things.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s? It's where I am. The bell's cracked, the sky's grey, and nobody leaves. Home, I suppose.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: I've watched every season pass over %2$s from the same window. They blur together after a while.
dialogue.conversations.people.first: They're fine. We nod, we pass, we don't ask too much of each other. It works, in a grey sort of way.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: Good enough folk. Everyone here's carrying something. You learn not to add to the load, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Whatever's warm. Warmth is the point; the taste is a bonus I've stopped expecting.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Bread and broth. Nothing that raises hopes it can't meet. That's my whole philosophy, really.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: My life is a long corridor of Tuesdays, %1$s. But there were a few Sundays. I'll tell you about those.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: A long grey corridor with a few bright doors. I remember every bright door, %1$s. Sit.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: I used to dream big. Now I dream the roof doesn't leak. Aim small, miss small.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: I dream the roof holds and the winter's short. I stopped dreaming bigger; it hurt less.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That the best days already happened and I wasn't paying attention.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: That the good part's behind me and I blinked through it. That's the one that keeps me up.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You make the corridor of Tuesdays feel shorter. Don't make me repeat that.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: You make the grey days a shade lighter, %1$s. That's as close to a love song as I get.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.first: Regrets are the only thing I collect. Pick a shelf, any shelf.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.first/1: Shelves of them. I dust them sometimes. Don't ask me to read the labels aloud.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: No. Some cellars stay shut, especially for strangers.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: That door's shut, and strangers don't get a key. Come back when you're not one.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: You want the deep water? You haven't even gotten your boots wet, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: Deep water, that. You're still ankle-deep, %1$s. Wade a while first.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing happens here. That's the whole tragedy of the place.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Nothing. Nothing ever. That's the quiet tragedy of a place like this.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy is a strong word. Content, though. Dangerously close to happy. Because of you.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: Happy's a big word for me. But the grey lifts when you're near. That's my version of it.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.open: Everything weighs, love. But since it's you asking... sit. I'll share the heavy end.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.open/1: It all weighs, love. But you asked, so — sit. I'll hand you the heavy end for a while.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage: %2$s and %3$s got married. Give it time — even the sunniest morning clouds over. Still, let them have today.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.marriage/1: %2$s wed %3$s. Everyone's cheering now, nobody's thinking about the winters ahead. That's the mercy of weddings, I suppose.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce: %2$s and %3$s split. Saw that storm from a mile off. Nobody ever does, though, until it's right overhead.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorce/1: So %2$s and %3$s are done. Love ends the way everything ends around here — quietly, and then it's just grey again.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: %2$s is gone. That's the one appointment none of us miss. I'll miss them, though. Truly.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/1: We buried %2$s. The village carries on, because it always does. Doesn't make it any lighter, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s was born. A new little soul walking into all this. Poor thing. ...Still, I hope it's kinder to them than it was to most of us.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/1: There's a baby now — %2$s. Bright and new, for a while at least. I'll let myself be glad for it. Just for a while.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival: %2$s moved in. Fresh face, big hopes. This place has a way of greying those out. Let's hope they last longer than most.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.arrival/1: Someone called %2$s came to settle here. They'll learn what the rest of us already know soon enough. Welcome to it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure: %2$s left for good. Smart, maybe. Everyone who can leave, does. The rest of us just... stay, and stay grey.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.departure/: %2$s packed up and went. One less familiar face at the well. They all thin out eventually, %1$s. That's just how it goes.
